regime_context: Narrow leadership in Semiconductors and AI Compute with only 23% of themes eligible. The absolute-trend gate has historically failed to reduce drawdown in this mean-reverting market (gate_helps=false), so trend signals are display-only. Given the weak track record (44% directional accuracy over 9 calls) and the detector's lack of forward edge, any directional leans must be low-conviction and falsifiable.
emerging_watch: Watch for a confirmed handoff from Semiconductors to AI Compute & Optics: if AI Compute overtakes Semiconductors in momentum rank and becomes the headline leader with margin >0.1, it would mark a confirmed rotation. Kill criterion: Semiconductors rebuilds a lead margin >0.3 or both fall out of the top 3.

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Momentum leader with trend continuity (hurst=trend) and no crowding flag, suggesting near-term relative strength may persist. The absolute-trend eligibility gate and top rank offer a focus lens, but the broad mean-reverting tape and a tiny margin over the challenger make sustained leadership uncertain.
theses.dissent: The market historically mean-reverts, and the trend gate did not reduce drawdown here. A macro shock or rotation could abruptly reverse this leadership, especially with such a narrow margin to AI Compute.

falsifier.text: Semiconductors falls below rank 3 or loses eligibility (absolute-trend gate turns false) within the horizon.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: Challenger with strong momentum and no crowding, benefiting from the AI tech narrative backdrop. The slim margin to the leader and low absorption suggest an unresolved rotation, making a tilt towards this theme a conditional bet on further convergence.
theses.dissent: Durability is mixed and breadth is low (0.235). The theme could stall if the challenger status fails to convert into outright leadership, especially in a mean-reverting tape where momentum mean-reverts quickly.

falsifier.text: AI Compute drops out of the top 3 ranks or its durability_bar falls below 0.4.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Despite high durability and trend health, the theme is flagged as crowded (z=1.24). Crowding is a size-down caution, not a fade, so an underweight reflects a prudent reduction relative to benchmark.
theses.dissent: The trend is strong and durability is the highest of all themes; crowding may not unwind quickly and could be sustained by structural inflows into healthcare innovation.

falsifier.text: Crowding z-score drops below 1.0 and durability remains above 0.8, indicating positioning has normalized while trend remains intact.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
